text:
maya: Draft RN for tonight's micro-release (runtime v2.3.5). Change window: 23:00 PST -> 00:30 PST. Main bullets: 1) batching latency regression fix (hot path), 2) autoscale tweak for Dedicated pools, 3) KV cache miss NPE fix. Please quick-review RN copy + confirm rollback criteria and who'll be on standby.

sam-ops: I'm on standby for the window. I'll queue deploybot once we lock the canary plan. Canaries: 5% -> 25% -> 100%, increment every 10m if metrics are green. Rollback criteria proposal: sustained error rate >= 3% for 5 minutes OR P95 latency > 800ms for 10 minutes. Thoughts?

jen: LGTM on the bullets. Small ask: call out "Dedicated customers may see brief reconnections" in the RN under "Known impacts". I've updated the RN snippet in the doc.

tom: Quick wording nit: change "kv-cache miss" to "KV cache miss handling" in the first bullet. Also confirm pin for fallback: we should pin to runtime v2.3.4 in routing table for 30m post-deploy so rollback is instant.

lina: Add: alerting runbook link and who to call for oncall escalation. Putting link to runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/runtime-deploy (please confirm access).

sam-ops: Deploybot queued. Summary of deploy command I'll run once we get a green from staging smoke:
```
/deploy service=runtime version=v2.3.5 canary=5% step=10m health=svc-metrics-check
```
I'll run the increment workflow: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with manual checks at each step. If we breach rollback criteria I'll abort and run rollback.

deploybot: deploy queued by sam-ops. Staging smoke passed at 20:43 UTC. Canary plan: 5% for 10m -> increase to 25% if no alerts -> increase to 100% after another 10m. To cancel: `deploybot cancel 1765432123`.

sam-ops: Rollback command (manual):
```
deploybot rollback --service runtime --to-version v2.3.4 --reason "canary failure" --force
```
I will also pin routing to v2.3.4 during rollback: `routing pin runtime v2.3.4 --duration 30m`.

maya: Thanks. Two open items: 1) Lina, confirm runbook link and escalation PD. 2) Jen, update RN with the dedicated/known-impacts line (we'll cut the microcopy to a 1-line bullet). After that I'll cut the internal announcement: 22:30 PT staff brief, 22:45 internal blast, 23:00 deploy.

jen: Done — RN updated. I left the microcopy short: "Dedicated customers may experience a short reconnect window; no data loss expected."

lina: Runbook link is correct, paging list includes @oncall-runtime and @infra-ops. Good to go from my side.

maya: Perfect. Final sanity: everyone OK with the rollback thresholds and the 30m pin on fallback?

tom: OK from infra. If we see repeated KV cache NPE after canary, escalate to eng-runtime immediately and do rollback.

sam-ops: I'll start the deploy at 23:00 PT unless someone yells hold. Deploybot will post progress here. :rocket:

maya: Thanks team — cutting internal brief now and scheduling the deploybot runbook message.
